subject: Lareth the Beautiful
fact: Lareth the Beautiful was the leader of the Fire Temple in the Moathouse, killed by Sequoia after being reduced to one hit point and paralyzed two party members with Hold Person.
source_quote: Lareth used his magic to paralyze Zephyr and Zinnia with Hold Person, but was felled by Sequoia's killing blow.

subject: Sarge
fact: Sarge was Lareth's sergeant, who relentlessly assaulted Calmer during the battle in the Moathouse and was later dispatched after Lareth's death.
source_quote: Calmer focused on healing himself under the relentless assault of Lareth's sergeant, Sarge.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr used Dust of Disappearance to become invisible, attacked an illusory Lareth, and was paralyzed by Hold Person before the battle's end.
source_quote: Zephyr emerged from invisibility and attacked one of the illusory Lareths, confirming it was a fake before retreating to hide again.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia engaged Lareth's guards, helped clear a path through the room, and was paralyzed by Hold Person during the battle.
source_quote: Zinnia and Sequoia immediately engaged the visible guards, quickly dispatching several of Lareth's goons.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia engaged guards, delivered the killing blow to Lareth, gained Uncanny Dodge upon leveling up, and was not paralyzed during the final moments of the battle.
source_quote: Sequoia, who was not paralyzed, struck the killing blow, felling Lareth the Beautiful.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was severely wounded by Inflict Wounds from Lareth, burned his healing magic early to stay in the fight, and focused on self-healing under Sarge's assault.
source_quote: Lareth severely wounded Calmer with Inflict Wounds. Calmer was forced to burn his healing magic early to stay in the fight.

subject: Thorne (Duke)
fact: Thorne (Duke) was hired by the party for a 50 GP fee to clean up the Moathouse after Lareth's death.
source_quote: The party contacted Thorne (Duke), agreeing to pay him a 50 GP fee for the clean-up job.

subject: Osler Goodingut
fact: Osler Goodingut was a council member in Hommlet who was presented with proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and agreed with the call to Nulb.
source_quote: They presented their undeniable proof... to the local council members: Osler Goodingut, Burne, Rufus, and Jaroo.

subject: Burne
fact: Burne was a council member in Hommlet who was presented with proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and agreed with the call to Nulb.
source_quote: They presented their undeniable proof... to the local council members: Osler Goodingut, Burne, Rufus, and Jaroo.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus was a council member in Hommlet who was presented with proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and agreed with the call to Nulb.
source_quote: They presented their undeniable proof... to the local council members: Osler Goodingut, Burne, Rufus, and Jaroo.

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo was a council member in Hommlet who asserted that the next vital step was for the party to travel to Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations.
source_quote: Jaroo asserted that the next step was vital: the party must travel to the city of Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple was a faction led by Lareth the Beautiful in the Moathouse, focused on the Chest of Rao, and destroyed after Lareth's death.
source_quote: Lareth the Beautiful... ending the reign of the Fire Temple leader in the Moathouse.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil was the overarching organization responsible for Lareth's operations in the Moathouse and now has active operations in Nulb.
source_quote: They presented their undeniable proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence...

subject: Gnoll King
fact: The Gnoll King was an ally of Lareth's, commanding a group of eight Gnolls in the Moathouse dungeon who were deceived by the party.
source_quote: They encountered a large group of eight Gnolls who were allies of Lareth's via a local Gnoll King.

subject: Bugbears
fact: Six intelligent Bugbears guarded a chamber in the Moathouse dungeon and were manipulated by the party into attacking the Gnolls.
source_quote: Further exploration led them to a chamber guarded by six intelligent Bugbears... they successfully persuaded the Bugbears to run off and fight the Gnolls.

subject: Gnolls
fact: Eight Gnolls were encountered in the Moathouse dungeon as allies of Lareth; they were deceived and stalled by the party using misinformation.
source_quote: They encountered a large group of eight Gnolls... convinced the Gnolls that Lareth was merely 'busy' and that a pay raise was imminent.

subject: Bugbears
fact: Six intelligent Bugbears guarded a chamber in the Moathouse dungeon and were manipulated into fleeing to attack the Gnolls for plunder.
source_quote: They successfully persuaded the Bugbears to run off and fight the Gnolls for the plunder.

subject: Mace of Smiting
fact: A magic mace looted from Lareth's quarters after his death; it was part of the treasure found in the Moathouse.
source_quote: Magic Items: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail... and a Ring of Free Action.

subject: Magical Plate Mail
fact: Magical plate mail looted from Lareth's quarters; it could not be worn by any party member.
source_quote: Magic Items: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail (which no one could wear), and a Ring of Free Action.

subject: Ring of Free Action
fact: A magic ring looted from Lareth's quarters; it was part of the treasure found in the Moathouse.
source_quote: Magic Items: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail... and a Ring of Free Action.

subject: Silver service set
fact: A silver service set worth 2,000 GP looted from Lareth's quarters after his death.
source_quote: Wealth: A silver service set worth 2,000 GP...

subject: Fire opal necklace
fact: A fire opal necklace worth 3,500 GP looted from Lareth's quarters after his death.
source_quote: Wealth: ...a fire opal necklace worth 3,500 GP...

subject: Chest of Rao
fact: The Chest of Rao was the target of Lareth's operations, stolen from the Deep Temple, and remained in the party's possession after the Moathouse was cleared.
source_quote: The session concluded with the adventurers poised to head north to Nulb, still in possession of the invaluable Chest of Rao.

subject: Dust of Disappearance
fact: A magical powder used by Zephyr to become invisible during the battle in the Moathouse.
source_quote: Zephyr using a dose of Dust of Disappearance to become invisible...

subject: Mirror Image
fact: A spell cast by Lareth that created illusory duplicates of himself to confuse attackers during the battle.
source_quote: Lareth retaliated by summoning a Mirror Image of himself, confusing his attackers...

subject: Inflict Wounds
fact: A spell cast by Lareth that severely wounded Calmer during the battle.
source_quote: Lareth severely wounded Calmer with Inflict Wounds.

subject: Hold Person
fact: A spell cast by Lareth that paralyzed Zephyr and Zinnia, immobilizing the two primary damage dealers.
source_quote: Lareth used his magic to paralyze both Zephyr and Zinnia with Hold Person...

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse was the site of Lareth's operations, the battle against his guards, and the party's successful clearance and looting of treasure.
source_quote: The party positioned in Lareth the Beautiful's inner sanctum in the Moathouse... successfully cleared out the Moathouse operation.

subject: Hommlet
fact: Hommlet was the nearby town where the party returned to present evidence to the council and plan their next move to Nulb.
source_quote: Finally, the party returned to Hommlet and gathered the local council members...

subject: Nulb
fact: Nulb is the next target city where the Temple of Elemental Evil has active operations, and the party is now preparing to travel there.
source_quote: Jaroo asserted that the next step was vital: the party must travel to the city of Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there.

subject: Battle in the Moathouse
fact: The party fought and defeated Lareth and his guards in the Moathouse, using deception, invisibility, and magic to overcome resistance.
source_quote: The fight began with Zephyr using Dust of Disappearance... Sequoia struck the killing blow, felling Lareth the Beautiful.

subject: Deception of the Gnolls
fact: The party deceived eight Gnolls into believing Lareth was still alive and that a pay raise was coming, preventing them from discovering his body.
source_quote: Using deception, they successfully convinced the Gnolls that Lareth was merely 'busy' and that a pay raise was imminent.

subject: Manipulation of the Bugbears
fact: The party used chaos and misinformation to convince six Bugbears that the Moathouse was open for pillaging, leading them to attack the Gnolls.
source_quote: They told the Bugbears that Lareth was dead and that the entire Moathouse was now ripe for pillaging... persuaded the Bugbears to run off and fight the Gnolls.

subject: Presentation to the Hommlet Council
fact: The party presented undeniable proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and Lareth's death to the Hommlet council, securing their mandate to act.
source_quote: They presented their undeniable proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and the death of Lareth.

subject: Level Up
fact: All four adventurers gained a level after defeating Lareth and clearing the Moathouse, acquiring new abilities including Sequoia's Uncanny Dodge.
source_quote: All four adventurers gained a level, increasing their power and acquiring new abilities, such as Sequoia's Uncanny Dodge.

subject: Infiltration of Nulb
fact: The party must now travel to Nulb to infiltrate the Temple of Elemental Evil's operations, disrupt their machinations, and identify who is truly in charge.
source_quote: Jaroo asserted that the next step was vital: the party must travel to the city of Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there, disrupt their machinations, and identify who was truly in charge.

subject: Secret Mechanism in the Moathouse
fact: A secret mechanism that dropped an iron grate and triggered a trap when a false wall was pulled was discovered but not fully resolved.
source_quote: They also discovered a secret mechanism that dropped an iron grate, blocking a passage, and found evidence that pulling a seemingly false wall triggered a trap related to the grate.

subject: session end
fact: The session concluded with the adventurers preparing to head north to Nulb, still in possession of the Chest of Rao.
source_quote: The session concluded with the adventurers poised to head north to Nulb, still in possession of the invaluable Chest of Rao.
